people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Now therefore, Yahweh, the God of Israel, let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant David.
translations.bsb: And now, O LORD, God of Israel, please confirm what You promised to Your servant David.
translations.kjv: Now then, O LORD God of Israel, let thy word be verified, which thou hast spoken unto thy servant David.
translations.asv: Now therefore, O Jehovah, the God of Israel, let thy word be verified, which thou spakest unto thy servant David.
